question: What practice concerning the soul has been told to the addressee, and to whom is it addressed?
premises: This practice of the soul has been told.
It has been told to you.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of the practice is not detailed in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
